panel.title: Body measurements
panel.subtitle: Avatar studio
panel.description: Adjust your measurements and see the changes on your digital twin.

viewer.hint: Drag to rotate · Scroll to zoom
viewer.loadError: Could not load the avatar; showing a simple model.

unreachable.label: Warning: target measurement not reachable
unreachable.tip: This body model cannot reach the target exactly; the closest value is ≈ {{value}} cm.

gender.label: Gender
gender.help: Set body shape along the female to male range.

heightCm.label: Height
heightCm.help: Stand straight and measure from the floor to the top of your head without shoes.

shoulderCm.label: Shoulder width
shoulderCm.help: Measure across your back between the shoulder tips.

neckCm.label: Neck circumference
neckCm.help: Wrap the tape loosely around the base of your neck.

chestCm.label: Chest circumference
chestCm.help: Measure around the fullest part of your chest, keeping the tape level.

hipCm.label: Hip circumference
hipCm.help: Measure around the widest part of your hips.

thighCm.label: Thigh circumference
thighCm.help: Measure around the widest part of your thigh.

upperArmCm.label: Upper arm circumference
upperArmCm.help: Measure around the widest part of your relaxed upper arm.

armLengthCm.label: Arm length
armLengthCm.help: Measure along your arm from shoulder tip to wrist.

inseamCm.label: Inseam
inseamCm.help: Measure from crotch to floor along the inner leg.

shoeSize.label: Shoe size
shoeSize.help: Shoe conversions are approximate and may vary by brand.

shoeSystem.label: Size system
shoeSystem.help: Select your preferred shoe sizing system.
